text: LIX. 1. Aṭṭh'; ime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame aṭṭha? 2. Sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno. Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti. Cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā: esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññāsīlasamāhito. Yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekhānapāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti.
